SELECT e.drama_id AS drama_id, COUNT(*) AS episode_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.episode_number <= d.free_episode_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS free_playable_count FROM episodes e JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE e.status = 'published' AND e.bunny_video_id <> '' GROUP BY e.drama_id
SELECT * FROM episodes WHERE drama_id IN #{dramaId} AND status = 'published' AND bunny_video_id <> '' ORDER BY drama_id, episode_number
SELECT drama_id AS drama_id, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'published' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published FROM episodes WHERE drama_id IN #{dramaId} GROUP BY drama_id
SELECT * FROM episodes WHERE id IN #{episodeId} AND status = 'published' AND bunny_video_id <> ''
